sources.note: Main website. Describes PCIS GOLD as all-in-one medical software with PM, EHR, patient engagement, and healthcare insights. Surescripts certified, ONC certified. Targets ambulatory practices.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists certified capabilities including medication/lab/imaging ordering, drug interaction checks, demographics, family history, implantable devices, care transitions, patient portal, CQMs. All features included in base agreement.
EHR product page. Describes medical charting at point of care, e-tasking, patient engagement, care coordination, mobile access. Light on specifics.
Practice management page. Details scheduling, insurance verification, patient registration, billing/claims management with claim scrubbing, A/R automation, co-pay collection, revenue cycle reporting.
Patient engagement page. Describes patient portal, mobile app, online appointment booking, online payments, digital intake forms, two-way text messaging, automated reminders via text/email/phone.
Medical charting page. Describes customizable charting with point-and-click and form-based entry, customizable layouts, ICD-10 compliance. Mostly conceptual — few specifics.

Blog post on core EHR functions. Covers clinical data access (diagnoses, allergies, meds, test results), CPOE, e-prescribing with dose/interaction checks, decision support, provider messaging, patient portals, education, scheduling, billing validation, immunization/syndromic surveillance reporting.
Blog post describing form-based charts built by physicians, custom healthcare plan macros, speech-to-text, NewCrop e-prescribing integration, cloud or network storage, automated reminders.
Lead generation page. Minimal product detail — mentions integrated PM, EHR, and patient portal. Shows ONC, MGMA, Surescripts, and Drummond certification logos.

Third-party EHR listing. Lists features including scheduling, e-prescriptions, patient portal, lab integration, immunization tracking, billing. Notes telemedicine and referral management as unavailable. Zero user reviews. Targets ambulatory practices, single-physician to multi-specialty groups.

Third-party listing with 20+ features including patient management, billing, e-prescribing, lab integration, secure messaging, mobile access, telehealth integration, document management, voice recognition. Zero reviews. Lists HQ as New York (possibly incorrect — other sources say Provo, UT).
Capterra listing. Returned 403 — could not access content.
Tracxn company profile. Page was JavaScript-rendered, no substantive content accessible.
Found in search results. Describes PCIS GOLD as all-in-one with charting templates, speech-to-text, macros, and one-click charting. Pricing ~$300/user/month for small businesses.
Found in search results. Indicates PCIS Gold has ~28 employees.
Found in search results. Lists PCIS GOLD as Computer Software company with 14 employees in Provo, UT.

DHI Computing Service, Inc. website. Parent company of PCIS GOLD, founded 1954. Operates four divisions: Amelicor (dairy), PCIS GOLD (healthcare), FPS GOLD (banking), GOLDPoint Systems (finance). Found via search results.

GOLDPoint Systems blog (sister division). Confirms DHI Computing Service history — founded 1954 by Bliss H. Crandall, first data processor west of Mississippi. PCIS GOLD originated from HPS (Healthcare Processing Systems).
